recipe.title: Sticky Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowls
recipe.summary: Sweet and savory teriyaki chicken with broccoli, pineapple, and a jasmine-cauliflower rice blend.
recipe.story: This bowl keeps the familiar sweet teriyaki flavor kids like while stretching the rice with cauliflower rice in a way that does not announce itself at the dinner table.
recipe.serving_size: 4.5 ounces cooked teriyaki chicken | 1/2 cup jasmine-cauliflower rice | 1/2 cup broccoli | 1/3 cup pineapple
ingredients: 6 tablespoons Kikkoman Less Sodium Teriyaki Marinade & Sauce
1 1/2 cups cooked Kroger Classic Grains Jasmine Rice
1 1/2 cups cooked Birds Eye Riced Cauliflower
2 cups pineapple chunks in juice, drained

ingredient_sections.title: Teriyaki Chicken
items: 6 tablespoons Kikkoman Less Sodium Teriyaki Marinade & Sauce

ingredient_sections.title: Bowls
items: 1 1/2 cups cooked Kroger Classic Grains Jasmine Rice
1 1/2 cups cooked Birds Eye Riced Cauliflower
2 cups pineapple chunks in juice, drained

instructions: Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and season with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Lightly spray a large skillet with avocado oil and heat over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken in a single layer. Cook for 7 to 9 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and the center reaches 165°F.
Reduce the heat to medium. Add the teriyaki sauce and sesame oil. Stir for 1 to 2 minutes until the sauce coats the chicken.
Steam the broccoli until bright green and fork-tender.
Stir the cooked jasmine rice and cooked cauliflower rice together until evenly combined.
Build each bowl with 1/2 cup rice blend, 1/2 cup broccoli, 1/3 cup drained pineapple, and 4.5 ounces cooked teriyaki chicken.
freezer_storage: Cool the chicken and rice blend completely. Freeze them in separate bags from the broccoli and pineapple.
If four servings remain, use gallon-size freezer bags. If fewer than four servings remain, use quart-size freezer bags.
Remove as much air as possible and freeze flat for up to 3 months. Add fresh pineapple after reheating.
reheating_instructions: Microwave the chicken, rice blend, and broccoli for 90 seconds. Stir and continue in 30-second intervals until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Add the cold drained pineapple after reheating.
tips: Drain the pineapple well so the bowl stays saucy instead of watery.
Mix the two rices before measuring each serving so every bowl gets the same ratio.
